modalLead: The Containers view grows up: a logs window that follows a container live, a Disk tab, notices when a container goes down, a timeline per container, skip, hold and roll back updates, and ticking several containers to act on them at once. Plus sortable column headings in every list view.

items.text: A logs window that follows the log live. l on a container, or Show logs in its menu. Scroll up to pause, search and filter the lines, pick stdout or stderr, copy or download.
Tick containers and act on them all. x or the box in front of the name; the bar above the list starts, stops, restarts, updates or mutes them and says how many worked.
Disk (d) shows what images, volumes and the build cache take up, and clears what nothing uses after asking.
Notices when a container stops, keeps restarting or turns unhealthy, and when it recovers, to your alert webhook and browser notifications. m mutes one container.
Updates you control. Skip a version, hold a container's updates, see what updates did, and roll the last one back.
The side panel shows Health and a Timeline of starts, stops, crashes and updates, and your own web UI address under the name, tagged Custom.
CPU and RAM columns, sortable headings, and a compose stack as one. Group by project, and its row starts, stops, restarts or updates the whole stack.
Shift Y opens Containers from anywhere, and the key legend goes above the list, below it, or away.
Updates are safer. An update keeps the container's volumes and settings, refuses what it cannot swap safely, and a failed one puts the old container back.
Every column heading sorts the list in the Bookmarks view and the Inbox; a second click turns it round.
A category's ⋯ menu names its sorts in full: Manual, A–Z, Last opened, Newest and Most opened.
The Inbox key legend lists only keys that work, and a link into the Bookmarks view opens on its default sort.
Settings saved at the same moment no longer undo each other, a failed save no longer says it worked, and restoring a backup writes each file safely.
Text still in English is translated in Dutch, German, French, Spanish and Chinese.
